title: Proposal for Public Consultation on Generational Ban on Smoking
what_it_is: Proposal for Public Consultation on Generational Ban on Smoking

sections.label: Tobacco-Free Generation policy review
sections.summary: MOH is reviewing the feasibility of a generational tobacco ban and will consider public consultation or other engagement to gather feedback on potential new tobacco control policies.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Health (MOH) is reviewing the feasibility of a generational ban on tobacco, also known as Tobacco-Free Generation policy, as part of our tobacco control strategy.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: As part of the review, we will consider public consultation or other engagement to gather feedback from the population on potential new tobacco control policies, which may be implemented.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: But what about the citizens' workgroup that I suggested as well?

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We are not closed to the different modalities of engagements, so we will consider this as part of our efforts in getting and gathering feedback from the public.
